script: We tested GTA 6 physics. Test one: crash a motorbike into a pole.
Test two: a carjack goes wrong, and the car flips onto its side.
Test three: run from a cop on foot. He tackles you into the bushes.
Test four: jump off a rooftop with no parachute. Yeah... wasted.
Test five: paddle a kayak on dry land. It actually moves! Which test should we try next?
facts: Bike hits a pole and rider is thrown (Quin69 clip RREUCZR4, 0.3-5.8 s)
Car launched into the air and lands on its side after a carjack (clip S7r-zxD3, 4.5-9.6 s)
Cop tackles player into bushes, Busted (Loserfruit clip jNZkh4GT, 33-38 s)
Rooftop jump, no parachute, Wasted (clip HO3GxS3G, 7-13 s)
Kayak moves on sand/dirt (clip LG0z7lwE, 15.5-22.8 s)
notes: Owner approved the 'I tested GTA 6 physics' idea 28 Nov. Narrated, voice only, game audio 0, no facecam, no streamer names, no credit line. Source = media/raw/physics/physics_src.mp4 built from 5 Twitch clips (two brightened).
